item.title: My agents wrote my posts. I posted none of them.
item.description: My AI agents wrote my posts for LinkedIn, X, Reddit and this blog, and none went out. What I changed in the Vale's To do so posting is one copy and one click.

item.title: My AI agents plan my morning before my coffee is done
item.description: Since today, the Vale gives me a To do with two lists: mine and my AI admin's. It plans the day while I make coffee. This post was planned that way.
